reviews.text: Every time I've taken my boxer there, the doctors have been wonderful. They take excellent care of him and explain in detail what's happening and the treatment plan. I definitely recommend them.
Excellent service, very peaceful environment!
Dr. Abril was very professional, and all the other staff were very helpful; highly recommended.
The doctors are very attentive and helpful; you can tell they love their work and have a vocation for service, always seeking the well-being of the animals.

I took my dog ​​in for an allergy, and the doctors' care and treatment have been excellent.
Dr. Greta, a veterinary dermatologist, explained the treatment steps very well, and now Ginger is much better. 🐶 Highly recommended veterinary clinic.
The only thing I would suggest they improve is the receptionists. They take a long time to open the door, sometimes disappear from the reception area, and you have to wait a long time to pay.
Bad experience and lack of professionalism

They are very professional. I took my dog ​​in for cancer treatment, and they discovered she had also suffered eye damage. Her cat sister had scratched her, and we hadn't noticed. We thought it was irritation from her bath, but they operated on her and provided follow-up care. She's already been discharged and only needs follow-up appointments. Excellent care.
Terrible service, they only profit from the suffering of animals and their owners.

A terrible and very painful experience. They sent me the test results 10 days after my beloved dog passed away. Taking him there was a mistake. They were very unsympathetic, and the doctors were very young and inexperienced.

Update: October 5, 2026. Since 9:00 AM, I've been trying to get an urgent appointment. I've made over 10 calls to different people, sent WhatsApp messages, and contacted both the Condesa and Polanco branches. They've already registered my information twice, and it's 5:15 PM and they still haven't confirmed my appointment. I understand they might be busy, but scheduling an appointment is simple. It's a shame because when the service started it was spectacular, and now they just leave you on hold.

Dr. Mara is amazing, and everyone's service is spectacular.

Terrible customer service. They supposedly have a customer service number, but nobody answers, or they take hours or even days to respond. Zero empathy and no available options to address your case. In my case, they didn't care at all about my dog's health, with no follow-up or interest in resolving a problem whose procedure they themselves suggested, without having the necessary equipment available. By the time they finally resolved it, I was the one who had to chase them down to get it fixed.

Very humane care for the dogs, but very poor post-operative communication.

I want to acknowledge that the care for the dogs is very good and humane; it's clear they care for them with love, which is why I entrusted my dog ​​to them.

My complaint is with the communication. My dog ​​had surgery on Friday, September 25th of this year. The following day, Saturday the 26th, in the morning, they informed me that she had vomited after the surgery and asked if she was taking any medication. I told them no and sent them messages throughout the afternoon to check on her condition since I couldn't make the visit. Several hours passed without a response; I had to call them to get an answer, and only then did they send me photos of her, because I requested them.

They discharged her on Sunday the 27th. They told me she had only vomited a little but that they would be monitoring her via WhatsApp and that I should keep them updated on her progress.

This morning, I informed them that she hasn't stopped vomiting, and I haven't received a response. Afterward, I asked if I should wait for their instructions or take her to the emergency room, and I didn't receive a response. Due to an unintentional error, I gave her a higher dose of the medication than prescribed and informed them immediately, but they still took several hours to reply. I asked if I should discontinue her other medications, and I still haven't received a response. I've called them twice, and they've diverted my calls.

I've attached screenshots of the conversations.

I hope you can improve your post-operative communication because it's crucial and very distressing for us as owners, which is why I would hesitate to have any further procedures done by them.
Neither their lines nor the 24-hour service in Polanco answered us, they didn't open, and the phone numbers don't even exist. What a bad experience; it's not an emergency service.

The doctors are excellent, but the reception, WhatsApp, and phone service take forever to answer, and at reception, they make you wait ages when you arrive. When I went, I had to wait over half an hour because the receptionist had forgotten to let me in.

They lost interest in animal health and are only interested in making money. I took my cat in for an infected wound. They ran 50 tests, inserted an IV, and after a few days in the hospital, they put in a catheter. Every day, instead of improving, the poor animal got worse. The last straw was when they asked if I wanted them to cut off his penis so he could urinate or euthanize him. I took him to another clinic where they told me the procedure had been a mistake, and in four days they gave him back to me much better. They're butchers.

They only charged me to see my dogs. They said they weren't going to give them anything. And it wasn't even a consultation. While my dogs were very sick, they didn't care about treating them.
Arrogant and overbearing staff. Disgusting service and disgusting "doctors."
I DO NOT TRUST THESE PEOPLE TO BRING ANIMALS FOR A CONSULTATION, ESPECIALLY NOT IN AN EMERGENCY.
The best care, they care about their patients and have good facilities, specialist doctors.

They're located in Polanco, they don't have parking, and if you're even a few minutes late, they cancel your appointment. I made the appointment because I was really worried about my dog. They gave me one three days later, and I accepted. Three more days of my dog ​​being sick, but I wanted her to be seen. I drove all the way from Pedregal, hit by two car accidents, had cars stopped on the way, and had a nightmare trying to find parking. I arrived 16 minutes late, and they told me they wouldn't see her because they only have a 15-minute grace period. I have to wait two days to get an appointment somewhere else, and my dog ​​will have gone five days without seeing a vet. I can't believe they're so inflexible when it comes to an animal's life. What a disappointment and a terrible experience. I really don't recommend anyone from here as your trusted veterinarian because they won't be there for your dog when you need them most.

They helped my dog ​​with what she needed, but they charged me for a test they NEVER performed, and since August 13th they've been supposedly processing the refund. It's the 28th now, and they've even stopped responding to my WhatsApp messages. Terrible customer service, but they're quick to charge, and it's not cheap. They should be more careful about that. It's practically highway robbery.
I went there for an emergency with my dog ​​and the service was very prompt and clear; I highly recommend them.

The service they provide is wonderful, excellent, professional, and ethical, at least in my experience with my baby 🐾 and the ophthalmologist who treated us. She provided detailed explanations, treated us with dignity and respect, and above all, showed empathy and a lot of affection towards my Shih Tzu. We traveled all the way from Acapulco for an opinion on the blindness that started in him. I would recommend them a thousand times over. Excellent service! Thank you!

Dr. Mara is amazing!!! We are so grateful to her. We haven't had very good experiences with veterinarians before, but she is super patient, empathetic, and loving with our dog. She explained everything to us very well and with a lot of care and patience. We will definitely be back.
Great service, we came for an ophthalmology appointment and everything was excellent, they were very kind and careful with my dog.
Excellent attention and service

The medical staff provides excellent care; it's well worth the cost because they are specialists.
I took my cat to the nephrology clinic, and we had a great experience with the doctor's treatment. She also took the time to answer all our questions. However, the doctors' excellent work shouldn't be overshadowed by the reception staff at their various branches. They either don't answer WhatsApp messages or take a very long time to reply, and since WhatsApp is the only communication channel between doctors and patients, it's sometimes very difficult to get through.

I'm writing to give my opinion about the poor treatment we received last Saturday. We made an appointment for our dog because we had previously been seen by polite and kind people who treated our dogs professionally. However, the surprise we received last Saturday was mockery and scolding from the receptionists, particularly one with colorful hair who didn't even bother to give my dog ​​the respect she deserved. I admit I was late for my appointment because we got lost and I had to travel from Satélite to Polanco and encountered some traffic. But that doesn't excuse the poor service and the scolding we received. The best option was to leave and not return to avoid exposing our pets to such bad treatment, as the receptionists gave us a terrible impression. Even as we were leaving, they mocked my daughter and me. I don't recommend this place because, personally, I've seen their service decline! Thank you for treating my family and my little dog.

DO NOT take your dog here if you have an emergency.

I went yesterday at 2:00 am and the vet on duty was aggressive and completely unprofessional. Even though it was an emergency, I preferred to find another place rather than leave my dogs there.

I do NOT recommend this clinic (go to Animania or Animalitos if you're looking for good service and care in Polanco).

On Monday, August 3rd, I had a cardiology appointment, and it was canceled 30 minutes before, even though I had traveled two hours. I've been waiting 48 hours for a refund, which they haven't given me; they just left me on read.

The service, from reception onwards, is good and friendly. The doctors who treated my dog ​​in ophthalmology were excellent; she's been on medication for a week and I've seen clear signs of improvement. Thank you so much.
Excellent service; all the staff are very kind and caring with pets. Dr. Greta and her assistant treated my dog ​​with true professionalism and love. I definitely recommend this clinic.
Very punctual. Dr. Saul Salgado is amazing; he explains things in detail and treats your pet with great pleasure! If you need an ophthalmologist, go to him.

Terrible service, with absolutely no ethical sense. The doctors try to diagnose the most expensive scenario, even when it's unnecessary, prioritizing billing over your pet's health.
They are scammers. The service you pay for is 24 hours, and they charged me for fluid therapy, even though my cat wasn't on an IV when I arrived. They charged me for 1 ml of medication at the price of entire bottles. In four days, my cat only got worse. I took him to another place, and they cured him perfectly and told me the previous procedure had been unnecessary. Awful service, and the doctors were very rude.

Doctors dedicated to their work.
Dr. Gaby at Catcare does an incredible job.
I took my cat (Chimis) there; she was in very bad shape. I rescued her from the street, and they treated her and operated on a hernia. She's already recovering.
The doctor always asks how my cat is doing and is constantly monitoring her progress.
The receptionists are 10/10 ❤️
Everyone is 10 out of 10.
Except for Jaime, I give him a 10000000000 out of 10 🐈 Excellent assistant and motivator for Chimis
It's awful that we have an emergency and your phone only has options 😵‍💫😵‍💫😵‍💫😵‍💫 …
Excellent service and attention

Many thanks to Dr. Fanny, Dr. Gaby, and Dr. Alex. I brought Kiara, a 3-month-old kitten I rescued with burns covering more than 50% of her body, to them. They treated her wounds, reduced her fever and pain, and beyond being true professionals, along with their wonderful team, they gave her so much love and restored her will to live. 100% recommended. Kiara will now receive care there along with her four siblings: two handsome cats and two beautiful dogs. Thank you to each and every one of them for their dedication to Kiara, and to our boss, Jaime, the best host, without a doubt.

My dissatisfaction isn't about paying for good veterinary service. I understand that specialized medical care has a cost; what left me with a bad experience was the lack of clarity and communication throughout the entire process. They definitely prioritize charging regardless of the care they provide to their patients.

I admitted my cat for a urinary obstruction and accepted an initial estimate. Later, I was informed that the prices had changed. As the hospitalization progressed, new charges, medications, and procedures appeared that considerably increased the cost, without any explanation or coherent authorization. As the days went by, only more procedures and medications appeared, exponentially increasing the estimate, but not improving my cat's condition.

Furthermore, they requested lab tests, the results of which they had in hand, but they were delivered to me five days later. This delay affected the treatment my cat received during that period, as the clinical information wasn't available to make timely decisions regarding my cat's outpatient treatment. I believe this situation reflects negligence in the handling and communication of the test results.

What finally made me lose trust was that I requested to take my cat with the feeding tube to continue treatment elsewhere, and they ultimately returned him to me without it, without having asked my authorization to remove it. They claim they don't do anything without my permission, but in the end, they did whatever they wanted.

My recommendation is to carefully review each estimate, confirm any changes before accepting them, and request the results of all tests in writing as soon as they are available. If you can go somewhere else, do so.
major

Hello, the care my Wido received was excellent. The examination and explanation provided were top-notch. The facilities were very clean, and the wait time was very short. The only issue, which was external to the hospital, was that the distance and weather (rain and traffic) prevented me from arriving on time for my appointment. Fortunately, I arrived at the last minute of the grace period. Other than that, I am grateful for the care and recommend bringing your pets there.

They're only interested in money. They don't care about your pet. There was a lack of transparency throughout the entire process. I admitted my cat for a urinary obstruction and accepted an initial quote. Later, they informed me that the prices had changed. They told me the catheter had become blocked and that they had to replace it at an additional cost, even though it's a 24-hour hospital and their job is to ensure it doesn't become blocked. I asked to take my cat out with the catheter in place to transfer him to another hospital, and without my consent, they released him without the catheter, despite my having signed a contract stating that no treatment or procedure can be performed or discontinued without my authorization.
Finally, I was left waiting for his urine culture, which they didn't send when he arrived, but rather five days after I called, saying the results hadn't come back. Terrible service.
Excellent service from all the staff. Very kind and attentive. The vet was excellent in her care of the dogs, and her diagnosis and treatment were very accurate.

Terrible service. They have no organization or control over the dogs or the different specialties. They don't care if your dog gets sick. The receptionist always does whatever she wants, doesn't schedule appointments, and wastes your time.
Excellent service
It's a good place, with fast and excellent service. And the receptionists are very friendly and attentive to my pet.
Everything was excellent! Dr. Saúl Salgado explained everything perfectly, and Ale Reséndiz at reception provided impeccable service. We are very grateful.

5 stars for the ophthalmologists, especially Dr. Susana and Dr. Saúl. They are incredibly patient and kind to the dogs, and their diagnoses are very clear and accurate. We've been their patients since October 2025, with follow-up appointments quite frequently 😅.

1 star or less for the admissions staff. They take forever to schedule appointments via WhatsApp. It takes at least six calls for them to answer the landline. If you choose to schedule another way (trying to avoid their ineptitude and poor treatment) via the specialty's WhatsApp, they don't schedule the appointment correctly. I've had problems three times now (once with Internal Medicine, but I messaged the day before to confirm, so there was no problem when I arrived; twice with Ophthalmology, where I confirmed, and even then, when I arrived, they told me I "never answered"). They should improve their staff, since they are the first point of contact. It's useless to have such good doctors if the admissions staff is so awful. We continue to go to the doctors, despite the nightmare of scheduling appointments.

The service was excellent. From the moment you arrive, you're greeted warmly, and the doctors at Eye are very friendly and helpful, answering all your questions.
I really appreciated the service. 😊
An excellent hospital, the staff are incredibly kind and wonderful with kittens; they know how to treat them and they love them.

Excellent service; it meets my geriatric cat's nephrology needs.
The doctor knows how to treat her so she doesn't get too stressed.
The staff is very friendly and professional; the veterinarians treat patients very well and give clear explanations. My dog ​​improved tremendously with the treatment.

Saturday, June 13, 2026, ophthalmology appointment. I arrived on time and announced myself. Thirty minutes passed, and I asked why I hadn't been seen yet. It turned out the assistant had forgotten to tell the doctor I'd arrived. Forty-five minutes passed, and I still hadn't been seen. There were three assistants, and when I complained, they became defensive. Terrible service.
I felt very calm; the professionalism and warmth of the doctors and the staff in general is evident.
Excellent service from the internal medicine department; the doctors are very attentive and careful when examining patients 🫶🏼 …
Bad experience, the staff's service is terrible. Especially from someone named Alejandra.
Terrible service. The treatment is inhumane. No consideration whatsoever for my pet's situation.

Good afternoon,
The service was not what I expected, as they dug their nails into a friend's dog; it was a very unpleasant experience. The person who attended to me was Ms. Alejandra.
Alejandra, the secretary, is the worst. She's rude, bossy, and has no respect for the people who go there. Because of her terrible service, I won't be back and I won't recommend it.
They treat pets very badly and the customer service is among the worst; the secretary has a rude way of treating people.

A very bad experience. The service was unfriendly and very rude.
I expected more attention and care for both the pets and the customer. I don't recommend it.
24-hour service
Good specialists, at least the one Mrs. was assigned.
I'm giving it 4 stars only because they need to clean the reception area more.

Excellent service at the front desk (in person). The veterinarian from Eye Care was very helpful and explained the entire procedure my dog ​​would need, including the costs of hospitalization and surgery. She provided us with all the information on the three possible scenarios for her eye (severe ulcer). Post-operative care was explained in detail.

Excellent value for money.
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating!
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating!
They have parking, it's the first time Boy
Thank you so much for your rating, Rocio!

I was requesting an appointment on WhatsApp and they take a long time to reply and then they just leave me on read, they never answered me again. I already found another place where they responded quickly and kindly.
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating!
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating!
The ophthalmologist is very good and has a lot of patience with the dogs and in explaining things to us.
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating!
Excellent service! We went for an ophthalmology appointment and the doctor explained everything very well and treated our dogs very well.

I really appreciated Dr. Mara's care. My dog ​​came in with recurring urinary tract infections, and she had vaginoplasty surgery. Everything went very well... they were very attentive to my Macarena's recovery and follow-up. I hope the infections clear up.

Excellent, professional, and warm care. Dr. Montiel from the ophthalmology department treated my Ollie accurately and promptly. I am very grateful for everything. I highly recommend taking your little ones to this specialty hospital.

We took my dog ​​to the vet for an emergency in the middle of the night, and the first thing we noticed was the lack of hygiene. The examination table and towel were covered in another dog's fur. But the worst part was the way they treated us. We felt they took advantage of our fear to overwhelm us with tests without giving us a clear explanation of why they were necessary. They gave us an alarming diagnosis to justify the expense.

Very happy and satisfied with the service. The way they treated my dog.

I highly recommend them.

My Chihuahua was seen in the ophthalmology department.
At the Polanco specialty tower.
Surgery.

He's doing well, and I'm beyond happy that he's okay.

Thank you.
Thank you so much, Elizabeth, for your 5-star rating!
Thank you so much, Nataly, for your 5-star rating!
Excellent service in all specialties.

Excellent service—fast, high-quality, and friendly. I took my kitten to the ophthalmology department, and the checkup was thorough. The team and staff are fantastic, and Neptunito is always treated with great care. He had cataract surgery and is also being followed up with a feline specialist. They have excellent communication with the Condesa Hospital. Everything is always explained to me clearly and with kindness.
Eyecare was very good and treated my cat very well, the only downside is that they ask you to arrive 10 minutes before your appointment but they made me wait more than 10 minutes after my appointment
Thank you so much, Miguel, for your 5-star rating!
The attention from all the staff was excellent, and the ophthalmology doctors were very dedicated and responsible.
